facts: C5N R5-R16 plateau cannot isolate propagation closure because all lower-zone ladder members shared a 10-cm bottom-adjacent state.
C5P proves at fixed D4 and D8 that thinning/reallocating bottom-adjacent state materially changes the high-resolution response under unchanged CURRENT_LAYER_FACE.
C5P D8 B10->B5->B2P5 is componentwise non-worsening on groundwater and profile views and retains correct sign/reversal structure.
C5P D4_B2P5 substantially reduces continuous errors but introduces 25 sign mismatches and a 25-step reversal penalty.
C4H-C4O exclude simple conductivity-focused or scalar existing-state gradient retuning as an authorized next remedy, but do not prove that a genuinely different closure is necessary.
identifiability.remaining_confound: At 2.5-cm bottom support, D4 and D8 differ not only in total dimension but in how much of the 10-150 cm column retains distinct state. The D4 timing failure and D8 clean response imply that broader vertical memory remains a live causal variable.
identifiability.why_D12_is_required: A D12 family can retain the same 5/2.5-cm bottom support while restoring substantially more vertically distributed state above 150 cm. This tests memory breadth without changing closure algebra or Reference physics.
identifiability.why_immediate_closure_is_not_identified: Because placement changes have produced large improvements and D4/D8 differ qualitatively in timing, the residual D8_B2P5 error cannot yet be uniquely attributed to inter-layer propagation. Implementing a new closure now would confound representation breadth with propagation physics.
identifiability.why_further_arbitrary_partition_search_i: C5P already establishes the direction of the placement effect. The next experiment is a bounded identifiability contrast with prospectively fixed D12 geometry, not response-based optimization.

D12_B5.role: same D12 budget, one upper state reallocated to split bottom 10 cm into 5+5

D12_B2P5.role: same D12 budget, 2.5-cm bottom support while retaining distinct state from 70 cm downward

D8_B2P5_control.role: same 2.5-cm bottom support with less broad vertical memory

prospective_D12_geometry.geometry_origin: D12_B10 is pre-existing R12; 5 and 2.5 cm are pre-existing C5C/C5P diagnostic support levels. The D12 redistribution is defined algebraically before any new response and is not optimized from C5P magnitude patterns.

prospective_discriminator.primary_question: With identical 2.5-cm lower-boundary support and unchanged CURRENT_LAYER_FACE, does restoring broader vertical memory from D8 to D12 improve fresh blind B14 dynamic-head groundwater response?
secondary_questions: Does D12 itself retain the D8-style B10->B5->B2P5 componentwise placement progression?
Does D12_B2P5 cross the independent R1024 high-resolution groundwater comparator?
Does added breadth primarily improve profile state while groundwater flux remains at the D8_B2P5 level?

outcome_logic.BREADTH_ACTIVE: D12_B2P5 is componentwise no worse than D8_B2P5 on the groundwater vector with strict improvement in at least one continuous groundwater component. Broader vertical memory remains causally active; do not identify a closure floor.
outcome_logic.PROPAGATION_LIMIT_STRENGTHENED: D12_B2P5 does not improve the D8_B2P5 groundwater vector while D12 retains physical/integrity qualification and its profile representation is at least as informative. This substantially strengthens the case that the remaining groundwater error belongs to propagation/closure rather than missing state breadth.
outcome_logic.MIXED: D12 and D8 trade different groundwater components. Preserve the mixed result and reconcile the component mechanism before any closure implementation.
outcome_logic.HIGH_RES_FRONTIER: If D12_B2P5 crosses R1024 on groundwater view, closure replacement is not justified by this workload; representation breadth/placement remains sufficient comparator-relative evidence.

closure_boundary.conductivity_only_status: Not supported as primary target by C4H.
closure_boundary.extra_history_state_status: Not supported by C4K in the tested state-space ambiguity diagnostic.
closure_boundary.next_if_propagation_limit_strengthened: Perform a read-only physically distinct closure-family derivation/discriminator before implementing any closure; separate gradient reconstruction, transmissivity/conductivity, and storage-consistent subgrid response.

constraints: Use fresh B14 prescribed-head histories not used in C5A, C5N or C5P.
Retain frozen Reference backend 1caa431... and the C5N/C5P high-resolution Reference qualification pattern.
Use D12_B10, D12_B5, D12_B2P5 and D8_B2P5 exactly as prospectively defined in C5Q.
Retain BC1 CURRENT_LAYER_FACE, constitutive law and candidate timestep unchanged.
Compare groundwater and mapped-profile views separately and report D12_B2P5 versus D8_B2P5 componentwise.
No scalar score, application acceptance, performance/speed or production-ROM claim.
